messages:
maria: Quick huddle: execs want a clean minimal 'scope floor' if we have to reset Nov -> Dec. We need an explicit pull plan and customer-facing mitigation.

devon: Agreed. My engineering list for the floor: public API (text + embeddings), auth (token-based), single-tenant routing, basic observability (request logs + traces).

sam: Runtime note: keep a single lightweight model family hot (e.g., small-llm-v2) and a fallback path to cpu-safe variant. Defer large model variants to v1.

alex: UX lean: remove create-team flow for MVP; allow one-off invite link for pilots. Saves ~2 frontend sprints.

jordan: CS input: Acme and BetaCorp will accept manual onboarding + documented SSO checklist for pilot, but they need sample SLA language.

tess: PM ask: define what "delivered" means for GA vs MVP. Is GA = enterprise SSO + billing per-route? Or is GA just public API + docs?

maria: Proposal: MVP GA (first public release) = public API, docs, single-tenant onboarding, telemetry, manual SSO for pilots. GA+enterprise = full SSO flow, per-route billing, advanced analytics.

devon: If we slip one sprint we pull from analytics retention, billing detail, and noncritical UX polish. Keep runtime fallback, KV prewarm, and autoscale config.

sam: Also add a short rollback runbook and model-fallback matrix. Something like:
```
1) Canary (internal) -> 2) Pilot cohort (Acme/BetaCorp) -> 3) 20% -> 60% -> GA
Fallback policy: if errors > 0.8% or p95 > 600ms, redirect to lightweight-model and throttle bursts.
```

alex: For front-end, I'll ship the simplified onboarding + a hidden flag for advanced options. Prototype by EOD.

jordan: I'll draft the pilot SLA + comms and send to legal for a quick review.

tess: Can we quantify SLOs for the contingency one-pager? Suggest p95 < 350ms for small-gen, success rate > 99.2%, and deployment rollback window <= 30m.

maria: Will include those. Also adding cost guardrails: per-tenant token/sec cap and a burst queue with auto-throttle.

devon: Ops item: identify what infra toggles we need to disable if we are forced to trim (e.g., cross-tenant batching, long retention traces). ETA 48h.

sam: Models list I'll keep hot: [small-llm-v2, embed-lite-1, reranker-mini]. Quantization notes: 8-bit for small-llm-v2 ok; defer 4-bit work.

maria: Draft contingency one-pager outline:
- Scope floor (must ship)
- Stretch features (if on time)
- Rollout cadence and rollback criteria
- Customer mitigations and pilot promises
- SLOs & cost guardrails

alex: +1. Also make the onboarding copy explicit about manual SSO steps in the pilot welcome email.

jordan: I'll prepare the welcome email draft and send to maria for approval.

maria: Action items:
- maria: build+share contingency one-pager (EOD tomorrow)
- devon: infra toggle list + minimal runtime fallback plan (48h)
- sam: models & quantization recommendation (72h)
- alex: simplified onboarding prototype (24h)
- jordan: pilot SLA + welcome email draft (48h)
- tess: consolidate SLOs for one-pager (24h)

release-bot: Scheduled preflight check in 36h before deploy window. 2024-11-07T02:00:00Z (will post updated readiness report)
__note: Per agents.md, no title field; messages are a single continuous string with sender prefixes. All fields are strings or list of strings.
